It provides M&A brokerage such as business transfers and share transfers, and support services for inuki transfers, in which a restaurant vacates the premises leaving its equipment and fixtures in place. "Inshoku M&A by Inshokuten.com" is operated by the company and its consolidated subsidiary Wit Co., Ltd., which also operate the "Food Accounting Association", a support organization for accounting firms whose clients include restaurants. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥277 million.
